blocks.title: Entra API Permissions — Expected vs Live (MCP API)

rows.status: Missing — not in requiredResourceAccess, no consent

blocks.title: Restore mcp.read — Microsoft Graph PowerShell 7
blocks.diff:
-# Live: requiredResourceAccess for MCP API = [mcp.write] only; mcp.read removed
+# Restore: requiredResourceAccess for MCP API = [mcp.write, mcp.read] + admin consent
+Connect-MgGraph -Scopes "Application.ReadWrite.All,DelegatedPermissionGrant.ReadWrite.All"
+$apiSp  = Get-MgServicePrincipal -Filter "displayName eq 'Contoso MCP API'"
+$app    = Get-MgApplication -Filter "displayName eq 'Contoso MCP Client'"
+$scope  = $apiSp.Oauth2PermissionScopes | Where-Object Value -eq 'mcp.read'
-$access = @{ ResourceAppId=$apiSp.AppId; ResourceAccess=@(@{Id='<mcp.write-id>';Type='Scope'}) }
+$access = @{ ResourceAppId=$apiSp.AppId; ResourceAccess=@(@{Id='<mcp.write-id>';Type='Scope'},@{Id=$scope.Id;Type='Scope'}) }
+Update-MgApplication -ApplicationId $app.Id -RequiredResourceAccess @($access)
+$sp = Get-MgServicePrincipal -Filter "appId eq '$($app.AppId)'"
+New-MgOauth2PermissionGrant -ClientId $sp.Id -ConsentType AllPrincipals -ResourceId $apiSp.Id -Scope 'mcp.read mcp.write'
+Get-MgApplication -ApplicationId $app.Id | Select-Object -ExpandProperty RequiredResourceAccess

blocks.title: PowerShell 7 / Azure CLI — Purge soft-deleted vault, recreate, grant RBAC
blocks.diff:
- az keyvault create --name kv-contoso-fin-02 --resource-group rg-contoso-fin --enable-rbac-authorization false
+ # 1. Confirm conflict: az keyvault list-deleted --query "[?name=='kv-contoso-fin-02']" -o table
+ # 2. Purge soft-deleted vault (irreversible; use recover instead if old secrets must be kept)
+ az keyvault purge --name kv-contoso-fin-02 --location eastus
+ az keyvault create --name kv-contoso-fin-02 --resource-group rg-contoso-fin --location eastus --enable-rbac-authorization true --enable-purge-protection true --retention-days 90
+ $kv = az keyvault show --name kv-contoso-fin-02 --query id -o tsv
+ $oid = az ad user show --id 'lynne.robins.contoso@c4a8shili.onmicrosoft.com' --query id -o tsv
+ az role assignment create --assignee-object-id $oid --assignee-principal-type User --role 'Key Vault Secrets Officer' --scope $kv
+ az role assignment create --assignee-object-id $oid --assignee-principal-type User --role 'Key Vault Crypto Officer' --scope $kv
+ Start-Sleep -Seconds 60 # allow RBAC propagation
+ az keyvault secret list --vault-name kv-contoso-fin-02 -o table # verify as operator; have Lynne retry

blocks.title: Blob tag verification — ledger-exports in stcontosofinprod01
Edit existing ABAC condition — keep tag gate, add ledger-exports
blocks.diff:
# stcontosofinprod01 — Storage Blob Data Reader (app-contoso-fin-reports)
- $condition = "((!(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/containers/blobs/read'})) OR (@Resource[Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/containers/blobs/tags:project<$key$>] StringEquals 'audit'))"
+ $condition = "((!(ActionMatches{'Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/containers/blobs/read'})) OR (@Resource[Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/containers/blobs/tags:project<$key$>] StringEquals 'audit' OR @Resource[Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/containers/name] StringEquals 'ledger-exports'))"
 $ctx = New-AzStorageContext -StorageAccountName stcontosofinprod01 -UseConnectedAccount
 Get-AzStorageBlob -Container ledger-exports -Context $ctx -IncludeTag | Format-Table Name,Tags
 Get-AzStorageBlobTag -Container ledger-exports -Blob 'ledger-2026-05.csv' -Context $ctx
 $scope = "/subscriptions/<subId>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/stcontosofinprod01"
 Get-AzRoleAssignment -Scope $scope | Where-Object RoleDefinitionName -eq 'Storage Blob Data Reader' | Select-Object DisplayName,Condition,ConditionVersion
-# Do NOT re-create assignment — RequestDisallowedByPolicy at mg-contoso-landingzones blocks new assignments
+Set-AzRoleAssignment -ObjectId <managedIdentityPrincipalId> -RoleDefinitionName 'Storage Blob Data Reader' -Scope $scope -Condition $condition -ConditionVersion '2.0'
+Get-AzRoleAssignment -Scope $scope | Where-Object Condition -Match 'ledger-exports'
+# Verify: app-contoso-fin-reports read on ledger-exports returns 200, other containers remain tag-gated
